title: NRL Labstracts p. 2: Richard Tousey portrait, American Academy of Arts & Sciences fellow
description: Page 2 of the NRL Labstracts newsletter featuring a portrait photograph of an older man in a suit with the article "Elected Fellow of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences," which names Dr. Richard Tousey, Head of the Rocket Spectroscopy Branch, Atmosphere and Astrophysics Division. Remaining columns continue articles on USRL, the labor contract and the savings bond campaign, plus a notice titled "Scrap Material Wasn't Scrapped."
